    q_check --> q_error: !self.has_referral_code(who)

1→---
     2→title: "list_rebates (protocol::referral)"
     3→---
     4→stateDiagram-v2
     5→    direction TB
     6→    [*] --> q_init: self, who
     7→    q_init --> q_alloc: coin_types = empty(), amounts = empty()
     8→    q_alloc --> q_check: check user_rebates_records
     9→    q_check --> q_return_empty: !self.user_rebates_records.contains(who)
    10→    q_check --> q_load: self.user_rebates_records.contains(who)
    11→    q_return_empty --> [*]: return (coin_types, amounts)
    12→    q_load --> q_iter: user_rebates = self.user_rebates_records.borrow(who)
    13→    q_iter --> q_push: has next key
    14→    q_iter --> q_return_full: no more keys
    15→    q_push --> q_iter: coin_types.push_back(key), amounts.push_back(amount)
    16→    q_return_full --> [*]: return (coin_types, amounts)
    17→
    18→    note right of q_iter
